children.text: A design studio with a love of detail.
We make websites, visual identities and graphic design for brands that care about quality.

values.alt: Hands turning the pages of a printed proof beside a tablet

children.text: A new website and visual identity

values.alt: A phone showing the Holm Partners website

children.text: Design is not about being loud.
And leaving only what is right.
We design and build websites with a focus on calm, clarity and good digital craft.
From the first sketches to the finished site we work closely with you on something that feels considered and lasts. We build on the platform that makes sense for you, and say which.
Graphic work that makes your visual expression clear and complete.
Presentations, print and digital assets that hang together and work in practice. A single job, or a design partner on call.
A direction that feels right, turned into an identity that works on every surface.
From the first thoughts to a finished, thorough expression, made with care and an eye for the small details.
Mørk & Lund is a digital design studio built on a love of digital design.
We work with websites, visual identities and graphic design, with a focus on good craft, a calm process and the small details that make a difference.

values.alt: A desk by the studio window, with a plant and a laptop
A portrait of Ida Mørk

children.text: Ida has more than five years of agency experience as a digital designer, specialising in visual identities and websites. She works strategically and as a whole, from the first idea to the finished implementation.
With a sharp eye and years of working closely with clients, she turns complex needs into clear, thorough design: digital worlds that are both visually precise and thought through in use.

values.alt: A portrait of Anders Lund

children.text: Anders has spent many years in digital design, most recently leading marketing design at a software company, where he shaped its visual identity across platforms, website and marketing.
He combines design and web development with a sharp eye for structure, detail and the experience of using the thing, and turns design into scalable, finished websites of high quality.

values.alt: Wireframes drawn on a tablet

children.text: “It has been a good and professional collaboration from day one. Mørk & Lund were structured, proactive and open, with an eye for our brand, our audience and ease of use. Having design and development in one place made it easy for us to run the site ourselves afterwards.”

values.alt: A hand sketching screens on paper

children.text: “I gave them creative freedom and had little idea which direction they would take. The result was thorough and very detailed, the process easy and the prices fair. They have my warmest recommendation.”
